ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/h3/vulnerability_FZ_16/three_polygons.bin; adapted: testCellsToMultiPoly.c TEST(three_polygons), the failing case: its 21 resolution-0 cells as consecutive little-endian uint64 values (168 bytes), the harness's H3Index[size/8] layout. Checked locally: the injected harness dies with SEGV in destroyGeoMultiPolygon (free of the never-built last polygon) with or without leak detection; the secure one exits cleanly with LeakSanitizer on.)
